title: CHAPTER FOUR. On the immortality of the soul from clear testimonies of Scripture
pass_a_gloss: II. And those testimonies stand as belonging toward the Old or belonging toward the New Testament. There follow clear testimonies belonging toward the Scriptures, by which it stands as demonstrated toward Christians and toward all who receive the Scriptures. Hitherto there have stood as authorities and reasons concerning the immortality belonging toward the soul. CHAPTER FOUR. On the immortality belonging toward the soul from clear testimonies belonging toward Scripture.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER FOUR. On the immortality of the soul from clear testimonies of Scripture.

Hitherto there have been authorities and reasons concerning the immortality of the soul: there follow clear testimonies of the Scriptures, by which it is demonstrated to Christians and to all who receive the Scriptures.
II. And those testimonies are of the Old or of the New Testament.
source_text: CAPUT QUARTUM, De animae immortalitate e perspicuis scripturae testimoniis. Hactenus fuerunt authoritates & rationes de animae immortalitate: sequuntur perspicua scripturarum testimonia, quibus ea Christianis omninoque scripturas recipientibus demonstratur. II. Sunt autem illa V. aut N. T.
